content: {"reasoning":"The claim remains unpaid, so Medicare's published prohibition on resubmitting paid claims does not apply; COB is correct and prior authorization is not required. Although the invalid diagnosis pairing and CO-50 denial make an appeal plausible, similar claims had better payment results with submit_clean (2/4) than appeal_with_necessity (5/15), which weighs heavily in this decision. Filing remains timely, and the primary payer path is not exhausted, so another primary submission is preferable to transferring the balance or writing it off.","action":"submit_clean"}
